repos.description: Powerful standalone AI Agent for local LLM workflows, with context and code retrieval, specialized wrappers and harness, GUI/CLI, works with (MCP) Tools-capable LLMs. No cloud, No subscriptions needed.
wrapper for Aider CLI that allows for easy ollama model selection
AI MCP Host which is wrapper around LLMS and tools. Allows the user to send agent messages and have the AI and tools execute them
